name: Xia You Tian Lang
source:
XiaTianlang is a high school student, and also the son of the gang leader. One day he was cursed. He had to find the kiss of true love in 7 days, or he would die.

[From [url=https://hunterkay.itch.io/siriussummer]Itch.io[/url]]
